video.title: AI欧腐《独属于你/Exclusively Yours》
video.desc:
这平台上一堆一起翻了
Adrian Bleu is the hidden founder of Meridian's top law firm — and the husband of a man who cheats with his secretary. A deliberate one-night stand leaves him blackmailed. So he sues. Alone. In open court. Against an army of lawyers. Hedoesn't know the man he wakes up with is Kai Moreau — the most powerful heir in the country, in love with him for eleven years. Now the ex-husband wants him back. The mistress is pregnant. The new boyfriend won't let go. And when a drug lord takes his mother, the hidden billionaire is about to show the world what "exclusive" really means.

Adrian Bleu 是 Meridian 顶级律师事务所的隐身创始人——也是一个男人的丈夫，而那个男人正和自己的秘书偷情。一场蓄意的一夜情让他遭人勒索。于是他起诉了。一个人。在公开法庭上。对抗一整支律师大军。
他不知道的是，那个和他一同醒来的男人，是 Kai Moreau——全国最有权势的继承人，已经爱了他十一年。
如今，前夫想要他回头。情妇怀了孕。新男友不肯放手。而当毒枭掳走了他的母亲，这位隐身亿万富翁即将让全世界看见，什么才叫真正的"专属"。
